# My Virtual Classroom — repository instructions for Copilot

Read the root AGENTS.md for project constraints and the root PEDAGOGY.md and DESIGN.md for the teaching and visual standards. For any new or revised lesson, follow .agents/skills/create-virtual-lab/SKILL.md and its references even if skill auto-discovery is unavailable. Use `index.html` and `testing/electronics/resistor.html` for the authoritative **Vibe Discovery green scientific-journal UI**; the 45-minute What Is AI? lesson is a pedagogy and explanation-depth reference only, not a requirement to use the old white slide-deck layout or copy its subject.

Default to a complete 45-minute lesson (10 minutes of notebook notes), unless the user requests another duration. Explain before asking questions, define unfamiliar terms with clickable examples, animate the mechanism, and include meaningful experiments and feedback. Preserve repository paths, subject separation and the build; use the verification requirements in AGENTS.md. These instructions refer to the canonical files rather than introducing separate rules.

For an animated video or cinematic explainer, also read VIDEO-EXPLAINER.md and follow .agents/skills/video-explainer/SKILL.md. Use the pinned upstream tools in vendor/video-explainer for actual rendering. Keep videos separate from the default full interactive lesson; follow the classroom style, local dependency approvals and real QA requirements.
